title: WorkspaceRevision
description: Immutable branch-scoped Workspace filesystem head. Sandboxes mount one exact revision and commits create a new revision by compare-and-swap.
x-semantic-constraints: revision_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the revision excluding revision_digest
revision_number is contiguous per workspace_id plus branch_id
revision_number one has null parent_revision_id; later revisions reference the immediate predecessor on the same branch
a fork may bind forked_from_revision_id from the source branch while creating revision one on the new branch
content_manifest_artifact is immutable and validates against content_manifest_schema_id before the WorkspaceRevision is admitted
